in_sanskrit.name: Janavika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lady of the Sacred Word
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Janavika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Janavika is derived from Sanskrit words 'Jan' meaning 'people' and 'Vik' meaning 'knowledge'. The name signifies a woman who is knowledgeable about the people and their needs, a wise leader and a nurturer. In Hindu mythology, Janavika is a name of a goddess who is revered for her wisdom and compassion.
